# zenuml fixtures

- `basic.mmd`, `messages.mmd`, `fragments.mmd` and the comment lines of `groups-comments.mmd`
  follow the examples in the Mermaid documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/zenuml.html),
  MIT licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `runtime-sample.mmd` is the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample shipped in
  `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/zenuml.mmd`, MIT licensed
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples).
- `cjk.mmd` and the groups in `groups-comments.mmd` are written for this engine.
